pattern.description: Within the zoomed Reports flyout, the cursor slides down the list; each row it crosses flashes a grey hover highlight in sequence until it stops on 'Actuals Import Check'.
pattern.why_premium: The row-by-row hover trail works like a stagger and guides the eye straight to the target report in time with 'In this case', so the viewer always knows where to look.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to(cursor, {y: targetY, x: '+=10', duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out'}); build a timeline of tl.set(row[i], {backgroundColor: hover}) and tl.set(row[i-1], {backgroundColor: 'transparent'}) at the moments the cursor crosses each row (about 0.12 s apart, a stagger tied to cursor position), ending with the target row held.
build_hint.remotion: cursorY = interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [startY, targetY], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); active row = Math.floor((cursorY - listTop) / rowH); apply the hover background only to the active row (a hard switch, no tween).

notes: Filmstrip frames are zoomed crops of the submenu. b03's changed_share is 0 because the intermediate highlights turn off again by the end frame. The energy spikes match each row-highlight switch.
